Overview

Ever since I was a child, I've been obsessed with the tragic story of the RMS Titanic. In my senior year of High School, I wanted to express a dramatic & chaotic scene from that fateful night on April 14th, 1912. As I got more comfortable with oil painting, I decided it was time to deploy my idea into an explosively colorful capture of the climax of the tragedy.
